plugins.name: codex-delegate
plugins.description: Codex CLI delegation. PreToolUse hooks read every Bash, Monitor, and Workflow call; PermissionRequest hook is inert. Prompts and files are sent to OpenAI. Uses your ChatGPT Codex allowance or API-billed usage. Bounded cleanup reports CLEANUP_FAILED. Requires macOS and a signed-in Codex CLI.
